title: system connection add --ssh native fails rootless: ssh runs inside the user namespace and reads /root/.ssh
body:
### Issue Description

Running rootless, `podman --ssh` native system connection add fails with only `Error: exit status 255`. Plain ssh to the same host works.

The command runs inside the rootless user namespace, where the ssh it spawns sees uid 0. ssh then looks up its home from the passwd entry for uid 0, so it reads /root/.ssh/known_hosts and /root/.ssh keys instead of the user's. It can't verify the host key and exits 255. Podman also throws away ssh's stderr, so the real reason never reaches the user.

podman compose and podman image scp avoid this with registry.ParentNSRequired (compose.go has the comment "don't join user NS for SSH to work correctly"). system connection add doesn't have that annotation, and it isn't excluded in can_use_shortcut() in pkg/rootless/rootless_linux.c either.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. As a rootless user, confirm ssh user@host true works and the host is in ~/.ssh/known_hosts.
2. podman --ssh native system connection add test ssh://user@host/run/user/1000/podman/podman.sock
3. Optional, the same failure in its simplest form: podman unshare ssh user@host true


### Describe the results you received

`Error: exit status 255`
`strace -f -e trace=write` shows what ssh printed:
```
hostkeys_find_by_key_hostfile: hostkeys_foreach failed for /root/.ssh/known_hosts: Permission denied
ssh_askpass: exec(/usr/lib/ssh/ssh-askpass): No such file or directory
Host key verification failed.
```
`podman unshare ssh user@host true` also exits 255. Under unshare, ssh additionally complains `Bad owner or permissions on /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/20-systemd-ssh-proxy.conf`.

### Describe the results you expected

The connection gets added, using the calling user's ssh config, known_hosts and keys. If ssh does fail, podman should show ssh's stderr: nativeConnectionCreate in go.podman.io/common/pkg/ssh/connection_native.go never sets info.Stderr.

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Rootless

### Upstream Latest Release

Yes

### Additional environment details

Arch Linux, podman 6.1.4-1, openssh 10.6p1-2.

### Additional information

I tried --ssh native because the default Go ssh client fails on my known_hosts (golang/go#82871). Possibly related:
- #17090: image scp had similarly confusing SSH errors.
- #23831 (closed as stale): --ssh native isn't used for API connections, so even after the connection is added, the connection to the podman API socket still goes through the Go client.

comments.body: Hi, I'd like to work on this if no one already is :). I'm looking into `ParentNSRequired`, the C shortcut exclusion, and regression coverage.
